source_quote: After 2 h, 70% of cells remained viable, which is similar to the previous report (Han et al. observed 93% survival).
notes: Stationary-phase culture sub-cultured into fresh LB to OD600 ~0.1 and incubated at 50 C; survival expressed as % of CFU at t=0. Average of 6 independent experiments.

source_quote: After 24h, however, more than 99% had been killed, confirming that extended incubation at 50 C is lethal to E. coli.
notes: Text states >99% killed after 24 h at 50 C, i.e. survival <1%; no exact survival percentage is given in the text (value shown only in Fig 2), so response_value is null.

source_quote: While stationary phase cell survival after 2h at 50 C was approx. 70% (Fig 2), this fell to approx. 1% for exponential phase cells (Fig 4A).
notes: Exponentially growing culture (OD600 ~0.1) shifted from 37 C to 50 C. Approximate value as stated in text.

source_quote: ...only 101+/-43 uM extra indole was produced after 2 h, much less than produced by the 37 C control culture (352+/-61 uM) or a culture incubated at 50 C (395+/-80 uM).
notes: Stationary-phase culture grown at 37 C, supplemented with 500 uM tryptophan and shifted to the test temperature; supernatant indole measured after 2 h (Kovacs assay). 37 C control = 352+/-61 uM.

source_quote: ...only 101+/-43 uM extra indole was produced after 2 h, much less than produced by the 37 C control culture (352+/-61 uM) or a culture incubated at 50 C (395+/-80 uM).
notes: Same experiment as ecoli-temp-29216232-04; 37 C control = 352+/-61 uM. Authors attribute the loss to inactivation of tryptophanase.

source_quote: After 60 min at 37 C the heat-treated samples accumulated less indole than the unstressed control (Fig 1B; differences not significant except at t = 60 min), but reached the same level as the control after 24 h (617+/-83 uM).
notes: Different protocol from records 04/05: chloramphenicol-treated stationary-phase cells held 30 min at 55 C, returned to 37 C, then 500 uM tryptophan added; indole measured 24 h later. Level equal to the unstressed 37 C control.
